messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync — prospect (FinCo EU) wants BYO-CMK with automated rotation every 45 days + emergency rollback path. They also asked that every inference call be wrapped with a CMK decrypt (auditable) and logs retained for 7 years. Need brief answers for presales: throughput impact, recommended architecture, and what to put in the SOW so legal/security are happy.
priya_solutions: TL;DR: recommend envelope encryption + rewrap strategy so we avoid HSM per-token on hot path. That satisfies BYO + audit without huge perf hit.
alec_security: Agree with envelope approach. Key points for SOW: rotation cadence (45d), attestations (monthly), key escrow/escrow exceptions, log retention SLA (7y), roles for key ceremony, and incident rollback procedure. Include requirement: customer responsible for KMS credentials and attestation reports delivered to Redwood.
nikhil_sre: Performance notes: if you do raw CMK decrypt per request (no envelope) expect extra network hop and 5-20ms added tail depending on region; envelope rewrap reduces to ~<1ms per request since we cache data keys and only call CMK on key rotation or first use. Also concurrency/throughput: if they want high QPS we should batch rewrap ops and recommend a small in-memory cache with eviction TTL ~1h.
sam_sales: Good. Customer pressed on: "what's the rollback if rotation breaks?"
priya_solutions: Proposed runbook snippet: ```yaml
rotation:
  cadence: 45d
  staged_rewrap: true
  canary: 5% traffic 30m
  rollback: immediate-switch-to-prev-key
  audit: capture-rewrap-ids
```
alec_security: Add: require canary + automatic rollback if error rate >0.5% or latency regresses >30ms. Also preserve previous key for 90 days for emergency decrypts; document key deletion/retirement steps.
sam_sales: Billing question: they want an estimate of KMS calls impact on unit cost. Can we provide a short note?
nikhil_sre: Provide two options: (1) BYO-CMK with naive per-request decrypt = high per-call cost and tail latency; (2) Envelope with periodic CMK calls = low per-token overhead. We can frame as: "expect additive KMS provider charges for CMK calls; Redwood adds a small ops surcharge for per-request keying flows" — exact numbers to be done in quote.
sam_sales: Can someone draft 2-paragraph presales note to send tonight to customer? They need wording for their security team.
priya_solutions: Drafted short blurb below, feel free to copy: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYO-CMK) via HSM-backed providers. For production we recommend envelope encryption: data keys are generated under the customer CMK and cached by Redwood's runtime; CMK operations occur at rotation and initial key derivation only. This minimizes latency and request-level cost while preserving cryptographic separation and auditability. For customers requiring per-request CMK validation, Redwood can implement a per-call decrypt flow at increased latency and provider billing. Our SOW will include rotation cadence, attestation cadence, rollback runbook, and log retention terms"
sam_sales: Perfect. I'll send and ask if they want a priced quote for both options.
deploy-bot: Note: created doc /presales/byo-cmk-options-1718007777 for follow-up.
alec_security: One more operational note: require customer to whitelist Redwood IPs for KMS endpoints and provide contact for key ceremony. Also include pen-test window before cutover.
sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll post the note and tag if they want exact price numbers we'll involve finance/solutions for a proper quote. :thumbsup:
